answer: Rank each identity by personalized PageRank: a random walk that restarts at trusted seed nodes and follows attestation edges, scoring an identity by the stationary mass it accumulates. Mass enters a sybil grove only across its few attack edges; dense internal vouching along a self-built trellis merely recirculates what little leaks in, decaying each restart. Honest members woven into the seeded core collect mass directly. No cipher of mutual endorsement lets a thin-cut cluster manufacture standing, because the walk keeps draining back toward the seeds it trusts.
